name: Barnabas
bio: Joses, a Levite from Cyprus surnamed Barnabas ("son of consolation") by the apostles, sold his land and laid the proceeds at the apostles' feet for distribution to those in need (Acts 4:36-37). His far larger role in the early church and alongside Paul is told in detail in the chapters ahead. When Saul, newly converted, tried to join the Jerusalem disciples, they were afraid of him until Barnabas took him to the apostles and vouched for his encounter with the Lord and his bold preaching in Damascus (Acts 9:26-27).
